meta.title: SourceFolio — portfolios you can read the code of
meta.description: Discover developer portfolios that are online and whose code is public, by country, specialty and technology.

brand.tagline: Portfolios you can read the code of.

portfolio.title: My portfolio
portfolio.visitorLead: Sign in with GitHub: we look for your portfolio among your public repositories and you publish it in one click.
portfolio.step2: We find your portfolio among your public repositories.
portfolio.step3: You confirm, it is published. In under a minute.

me.title: Me
me.accountHint: Sign in to publish your portfolio, get feedback and follow its visits.

auth.permission: Access to your public profile only.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address leads to no portfolio. It may have moved or been removed.

account.deleteLead: Deletes your account, your portfolio, your profile answers and the likes you gave. It is immediate and final.
account.deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted. Try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.description: Your account, your portfolio and its likes, your profile answers and the likes you gave are deleted right away. This cannot be undone.

detection.searching: Looking for your portfolio in your public repositories…
detection.foundTitle: We found these sites in your public repositories
detection.noneTitle: No site found in your public repositories
detection.noneHint: Add your portfolio’s address to the “Website” field of its GitHub repository, then sign in again: we will look again.

reason.HOMEPAGE: The site set in one of your repositories
reason.PROJECT_PAGES: A project published with GitHub Pages

detection.publishFailed: Publishing did not go through. Try again in a moment.

showcasePage.metaDescription: {login}’s portfolio and the code that builds it, on SourceFolio.

banner.UNAVAILABLE: This portfolio is unavailable for now: its site no longer answers. It comes back as soon as it does.
banner.NEEDS_FIX: This portfolio is waiting for a fix from its author.

showcasePage.ctaLead: Sign in with GitHub, we find your portfolio and you publish it in one click.
showcasePage.ogTagline: A portfolio you can read the code of

catalog.loadFailed: The next portfolios could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
catalog.unavailable: The catalogue is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
catalog.emptyLead: Yours can be the first: sign in with GitHub, we find it and you publish it in one click.

intro.lead: Open a portfolio, visit the site, then read the code that runs it.

profile.signInHint: Sign in with GitHub to complete your profile.
profile.unavailable: Your profile cannot be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
profile.countryTitle: Which country do you live in?
profile.emailTitle: Your email, to hear about it if your site goes down
profile.emailHint: Optional. It is never shown or shared.
profile.failed: Your answer could not be saved. Try again.
profile.reminder: Add your country and specialty: two questions, ten seconds.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.lead: The portfolios the community likes most.
ranking.empty: The ranking appears with the first likes. Open a portfolio you like and like it.
ranking.unavailable: The ranking is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.

likes.failed: Your like could not be saved. Try again.

preview.title: Your card preview
preview.lead: What visitors see in the catalogue. Without an image, your card shows your site’s name.
preview.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB at most
preview.videoHint: MP4, 15 s and 8 MB at most, played on hover
preview.tooBig: This file is too large: 5 MB at most for an image, 8 MB for a video.
preview.failed: The upload did not go through. Try again in a moment.

journey.title: Your portfolio on SourceFolio

next.publish: Pick your portfolio’s repository: it shows up in Discover as soon as it is published.
next.preview: Add an image (and a short video if you like): it is what your card shows.
next.profile: Tell us your country and specialty so people find you more easily.

journey.doneLead: Your portfolio is live. Share the link to get visits and likes.

manage.title: Change or withdraw my portfolio
manage.lead: To publish another repository, withdraw this one first: you then pick the new one among your repositories. Its likes go with it.
manage.failed: Your portfolio could not be withdrawn. Try again.

changeDialog.title: Change portfolio?
changeDialog.description: Your current portfolio leaves the catalogue with its likes. You then pick another repository to publish.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw your portfolio?
withdrawDialog.description: It leaves Discover and the Ranking, its page no longer exists and its likes are deleted. You can publish one again later.

og.lead: Open a portfolio, visit the site, then read the code that runs it.
